low-bar-squat.criteria: Bar across rear deltoid shelf, planted feet, controlled hip-dominant squat with bar over midfoot.

cable-glute-kickback.criteria: Supported standing hip extension with ankle cuff connected to low pulley; stance foot and torso fixed.

band-good-morning.criteria: Loop band under both feet and over upper back below neck; soft knees, hip hinge and controlled return.

limits: Procedural human and simplified equipment. Sampled checks are not full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Local only; production and device pending.
